55:68.text: In both of them are fruit and palm trees and pomegranates.

55:69.text: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

55:70.text: In them are good and beautiful women -

55:71.text: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? -

55:73.text: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? -

55:74.text: Untouched before them by man or jinnī -

55:75.text: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? -

55:76.text: Reclining on green cushions and beautiful fine carpets.

55:77.text: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

55:78.text: Blessed is the name of your Lord, Owner of Majesty and Honor.

56:2.text: There is, at its occurrence, no denial.

56:4.text: When the earth is shaken with convulsion

56:5.text: And the mountains are broken down, crumbling

56:8.text: Then the companions of the right - what are the companions of the right?

56:9.text: And the companions of the left - what are companions of the left?

56:11.text: Those are the ones brought near

56:14.text: And a few of the later peoples,

56:16.text: Reclining on them, facing each other.
